items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The shared infrastructure layer containing core entity definitions, storage logic, and command dispatching that blocks all subsequent feature work.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential alphanumeric token assigned to each entry to ensure unique reference and retrieval.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage in ~/.todos.json and for machine-readable output.
The minimum viable product consisting of the ability to create and mark entries as finished.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of design documents including plan, spec, research, and data-model required before implementation.
The primary documentation file detailing usage and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration in pyproject.toml.
The specific implementation unit responsible for handling empty collection states with a user-facing message.
The verification suite divided into unit and integration directories.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the created_at field during entity instantiation.
The operation that removes all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable format.
A high-priority constraint indicating that no subsequent work can begin until the current phase is fully validated.
